name: qa-mobile
description: Mobile E2E testing: 8 skills covering native (xcuitest-suite - iOS plus the macOS desktop delta, espresso-suite), cross-platform drivers (appium-testing, detox-testing, maestro-flows), Flutter (flutter-testing), device-matrix dispatcher (mobile-device-matrix-toolkit), and mobile accessibility (mobile-a11y-test-author). Plus 1 agent: mobile-test-author (detects the driver from project markers, scaffolds a from-zero skeleton when no harness exists, then emits one test file per spec). For mobile-WEB viewport emulation, see playwright-testing in qa-web-e2e.
